name: Fold_Theatre
title: The Fold Theatre
description: The F-edge first cycle. Substrate cycles between Wolfram Rule 30, Sierpinski, and Menger sponge expressions on the same floor; subdivision intensifies where the player looks; flower-grammar paints concentric anatomy in petal/sepal/stamen/pistil colour bands; the path from spawn to teleporter is guaranteed by PATH_GUARANTEE. Same map, three foldings of the same algorithm, the same body walking through.
